opcodes.name: create-raster-context
opcodes.semantics: Compute-only context: no display, framebuffer, texture copies or scratch allocation.

io_operations.name: blit-indexed-frame
io_operations.semantics: Borrow INDEX8 image, RGB565LE palette, optional transparent-zero cursor and RGB565LE target. Preserve the legacy 320x240 logical sampling grid; no display allocation or present.

io_operations.name: blit-indexed-rect
io_operations.semantics: Synchronous borrowed INDEX8-to-RGB565LE rectangle. Exact nearest-neighbour sampling sx=floor(x*source-width/target-width), sy=floor(y*source-height/target-height), including 1:1. Same validation and transparent-zero cursor as 0x108; target offset/pitch allow a subrectangle. No writes on validation failure, no retained pointers. Disjoint target byte ranges may run concurrently and must join before return. The legacy 0x108 sampling is unchanged.

io_operations.name: execute-priority-tiles
io_operations.semantics: Synchronous INDEX8 8x8 tile snapshots into RGB565LE color and u8 priority planes. Transparent index zero; write only when compare-depth exceeds destination priority, then store write-depth. Validate the entire packet before writes. Commands retain per-pixel order; disjoint priority byte ranges own the corresponding color pixels and may execute concurrently, joining before return. No display allocation or present.

create_flags.name: borrow-commands
create_flags.semantics: Submit validates and rasterizes borrowed bytes synchronously. Never retains the input pointer. WOULD_BLOCK consumes no frame ID; retry after framebuffer progress. Host may reject unsupported mode at creation. Display remains asynchronous.

semantics: All fields little-endian. Version1.0; no reserved bits. Count1..min(context.max-commands,4096). Command-bytes equals32+count*24; source offsets are packet-relative and start at or after command-bytes. No implicit clipping or source masking.

Color and priority offsets address Guest linear memory, with pixel-count slots; color uses2bytes/slot, priority1byte/slot; pitch is slots/row. Both planes and the entire packet must be mutually disjoint. RGB565LE color is2-byte-aligned.

Each tile has64 INDEX8 bytes. Palette entries must be4,16,or256, each RGB565LE and2-byte-aligned. Every source index, including clipped pixels, must be smaller than palette-entries. Zero is transparent.

Source-x/y and width/height select a nonempty crop within8x8 in destination orientation. Flips apply to source coordinates after cropping: sx=flip-x?7-(source-x+x):source-x+x, similarly sy. Destination is the first cropped output pixel. Rows must fit the common pitch and both planes.
Borrowed command/source bytes remain immutable until return. The caller snapshots mutable cache/palette data before submission. Host writes neither source nor padding outside destination rectangles.

Parallel ranges use priority bytes as primary target units; color pixels follow the same indices. Each worker executes commands in order for its own pixels. Backends must satisfy cache/coherency alignment for both planes or use serial execution.

Any negative execution status leaves both output planes unchanged. A backend must reject before starting; after starting it must finish/join all ranges and return success. A caller may then render a rejected batch locally without an output-plane snapshot.
